<!-- pr-reviewer: d7b73ce9276950275e712a5713b3a511e1a42a3d -->
Needs changes before merge.

The blank and operation captures use selection commands and stable paths. The process-change line and decision record are present. No product PNG or golden changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs:234`: Update the PDF consumer for the new image filenames. `xtask/src/catalog_pdf.rs:59` still reads `<case>.png`. Thus `catalog --screenshots --pdf` silently omits the new images. An isolated local check used temporary render, pandoc, and Chrome substitutes. With `first-part.png`, the staged Markdown contained an image. With `0-blank.png`, it contained no image. Both commands returned success. Collect and stage the blank and operation images for the PDF. Add a test for the combined command.
2. `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs:232` / PR body: Add before/after screenshot links for the changed capture output. The body describes visual inspection but has no screenshot links. Put review evidence only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link it from the body. Keep the evidence outside this PR branch.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream main `acd5b02d3e36a12745b11038012240781129d43c` succeeded. All builds used this review worktree's own target directory. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: failed, one failed step of three.
- `app:example_catalog`: 15 passed, 1 failed. The failure is below.
- `ui:catalog_render`: 2 passed, 1 ignored. The new selection test passed.
- xtask: 207 unit tests and 22 integration tests passed. The collection/publication test passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The catalog failure is inherited from current main. Its test sources and catalog case inputs are unchanged by this PR. Main adds the groove/part-off case in a separate binary, but this contract expects it in `example_catalog`. The gate is not green.

```text
contract::every_case_has_two_named_test_results
crates/app/tests/example_catalog/contract.rs:23:13:
missing case test catalog_turning_groove_part_off::regenerates: test
```

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 1,289 passed, 7 ignored.
- `render_all_catalog_screenshots`, with `--ignored --exact`, `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`, and output under `/tmp`: 1 passed. Vulkan llvmpipe rendered all six cases. The seed blank and pocket views have the same framing and separate overlays.
- The isolated PDF check above confirmed the filename regression.

No fixture, golden, or importer changed. The extra kernel/import suites do not apply. The heavy dry-run selects `app:example_catalog`; that binary has no ignored tests. No release heavy lane ran.

Safety and mutations: This diff does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision/gouge checks. No safety mutations were required or run. No source code changed during review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. PDF generation now stages every blank and operation image in stable filename order. `catalog_screenshots_pdf_stages_blank_and_operation_images` pins the combined `catalog --screenshots --pdf` command. The old consumer failed on `0-blank.png`. The restored fix passed.
2. The PR body now has before/after screenshot links. All five PNG files are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `888016d4bd31c319cae6e39d66080fd3953e2991`. The link check failed without the links and passed with them. No review image or log is in this PR branch.

New head: `2b31dd853940c73768c767b65ee17db663d69a03`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: three steps, zero failures.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2b31dd853940c73768c767b65ee17db663d69a03 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both findings from the earlier review are resolved.

- The PDF consumer collects and stages the blank and operation images in stable filename order. The combined command test passed.
- The body has five before/after screenshot links. Each link loaded. The images show the same camera and separate operation overlays. The referenced commit is the fork's current `pr-screenshots` branch head. No PNG or review evidence is in this PR diff.
- Selection uses commands. The decision record and `Process change: yes` line are present. This PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream main `58cb641caa0a4c0b6d514c3e874ccaee1b8a6e5b` succeeded. Review used upstream main's current AGENTS.md. All builds used the review worktree's own target directory. No GitHub runner ran.

- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=8 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed, five steps, zero failures.
- App build with `--no-run`: passed. `catalog_groove_part_off`: 1 passed. `example_catalog`: 19 passed. The earlier catalog contract failure is resolved on current main.
- UI `catalog_render`: 2 passed, 1 ignored. The selection test passed.
- xtask: 222 unit tests and 26 integration tests passed. These include the collection/publication and combined screenshot/PDF tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 1,289 passed, 7 ignored.
- `render_all_catalog_screenshots --ignored --exact --nocapture`, with `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`: 1 passed. Vulkan llvmpipe rendered all six catalog cases. Output stayed under `/tmp`.

No fixture, golden, or importer changed in this PR. The extra fixture and kernel/import suites do not apply.

The heavy dry-run selected `app:example_catalog`. That binary and its included modules have no ignored tests. No release heavy lane ran. The explicit catalog renderer ran as stated above.

Safety and mutations: This diff does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision/gouge checks. No safety mutations were required or run. No source code changed during review. No goldens moved.

Limits: The combined PDF test uses renderer, pandoc, and Chrome substitutes. It checks staging and command wiring. A real browser PDF render and hardware GPU rendering were not exercised.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
